talks.text: Which country has the biggest army on Earth? And which ones have no army at all? 197 countries, one by one. Active soldiers only.
Yellow: up to two hundred thousand.
And purple... over a million soldiers! Let's go!
1.3 million soldiers... and we are only number three?
Andorra: no army at all! Spain and France protect it.
Luxembourg: 1,100. One of the smallest in Europe.
No army at all. Just the coast guard... and the weather.
Almost seven hundred thousand. Because we have to.
1.26 million. And one and a half million more in reserve.
Brazil: 374,000. The biggest in Latin America.
Panama: zero soldiers! No army since 1990.
Costa Rica: no army at all!
No army since 1948. We spend it on schools.
Saint Vincent: no army at all!
Syria: starting from scratch! The old army collapsed in 2024.
One and a half million! Number two in the world.
450,000 active... and five million in reserve.
China: 2.04 million. The biggest army on the planet!
Two million soldiers. The biggest army on Earth.
1.28 million soldiers... out of just 26 million people!
Solomon Islands: no army at all!
Marshall Islands: no army at all!
Libya: nobody knows! Two rival armies.
Egypt: 438,000. The biggest army in Africa... after Ethiopia.
Ethiopia: 503,000. The biggest army in Africa!
Eritrea: 302,000. Huge, for a country of under four million people!
Our army? 135 Swiss Guards. With halberds.
How big is your country's army? Tell me in the comments!

cfg.title: SOLDIERS IN EVERY COUNTRY
cfg.ask: HOW BIG IS YOUR ARMY? COMMENT!
